dwelling_habits.dwelling: Clear Caribbean reefs with caves and coral heads for shelter.
dwelling_habits.food: Mostly sponges, plus algae and small invertebrates.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Picks carefully at sponges — royalty with a picky menu.
dwelling_habits.mating: Pairs defend a home stretch of reef.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Shy of snorkelers but curious from a polite distance.

fun_facts: A blue crown-like spot on the head earns the royal nickname.

dwelling_habits.socializing: Overharvested in many places — check local rules.
